system.description:
Effect: Until you use a ten-hour recovery, you can breathe water as well as you do air. You can use this cypher on up to six creatures, in which case it lasts until they use a one-hour or longer recovery (one individual ending the cypher doesn’t affect the duration for other creatures).

Genre Items: potion of water breathing (fantasy); respiratory fluid (sci-fi)
